name: CHILDREN_CROSSING_25_WHEN_LIGHTS_FLASHING_WHITE_TALL
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R3-SA56A (450 x 1200) illustrated (B 600 x 1600), 2015, 1:10 ('Koala' pedestrian crossing, formerly R4-SA56); R50, white, no outer border. Top panel 295 tall (5 white edge + 10 black border, sheet 5 / 15; R45 / R35): CHILDREN 60 C baseline 125 (top 65) ink 318 (66/318/66), CROSSING 60 C baseline 235 (top 175) ink 317 (66/317/67), 60 below. 85 gap; red annulus outer dia 440 (5 margins), centre (225, 600); inner radius not stated — the ring measures 37 wide on the sheet, drawn R184 as the national R-series rings (36); 25 200 C centred (120 below the numerals; the sheet's '185' is not matched), ink 248 (101/248/101). 85 gap; bottom panel 295 tall (905-1200), same edge/border: WHEN 50 D baseline 995 (top 945) ink 172 (139/172/139), LIGHTS baseline 1075 (top 1025) ink 213 (118/213/119), FLASHING baseline 1155 (top 1105) ink 307 (71/307/72), 45 below.
